- work/names-decisions.tsv has 448 lines, so 447 names. That count is 326 at d6e1d6c78, 446 at ae8518d96, then 447 at d9aceb0ef, which added 域之兼 in the second whole-book review. So 326 names came from the map's texts and 121 from drafting (120 in the naming pass, plus 域之兼).

The same chapter has the same stale figures in other places. All finds below were checked to occur once.

(c) "未录引文的 200 个分两种：" → "未录引文的 201 个分两种：". The table has 201; 域之兼 is 新 with no citation.
(d) "104 个是新组合" → "105 个是新组合". The TSV gives 新 131 names, 105 of them with no citation.
(e) "41 个字或词不立为名" → "37 个字或词不立为名（附录同列的象、数、通三字各取一义，立为名）". This is §五·五, line 271.

The same stale figures are also outside the chapter. The landing_texts.py record template, line 60, hard-codes "41 symbols not adopted with reasons". It should read "37 symbols not adopted with reasons (象, 数, 通, listed with them, each adopted in one sense)". Its line 77 gives the two naming steps (326 + 120) without 域之兼.

The ZHONGHUA chapter contains no 446 or 41 figure.
